reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [...] and the [righte]o[usness of the Father] is more than [the power of] the voice through them.

This one, whom they called "approved" [, the reason they gave him this name is that] they approved him in the midst of the ae[ons of] light. These numerous multitudes set him a[part], and he came forth against the enemy. They gave this name [to him on account of] this matter [: the aeons] who are numerous, that are in the aeons of light and who [are without] measure or number.

This one, [whom they called] "righteous", because he is the first righteous one who had no sin amongst all of the aeons that belong to the light and the thought [of the Father. And] they knew him, so that [he came forth from the Father of Greatness, who sent him with his five sons to the land of darkness.]

Again, just as the only begotten ones from your [only] begotten race and you [are formed] according to flesh [, so is the o]nly begot-ten also from gold and silver and all the [treasures] of the universe.

[the F]irst Man, himself stood firm in the [midst] of all the worlds of darkness. He did not love [the] worlds of darkness, nor did he lust for them! Rather, h[is] thought and love for the household of his people is in h[i]m. Anything else that the enemy [wrought was] with his violent de[e]ds. Behold, (the First Man) toils and struggles; so that (the enemy) would be separat[ed from] them and be cast out from them. And he purifies them and ma[ke]s them f[r]ee, and makes them as they were from the beginning.
